note: Resource Allocation Register: the Category column is now an editable dropdown — pick any category to re-file a line and the row jumps to that group instantly (choosing the auto-detected category clears the override). Transaction Log: the Edit Log Entry dialog now has a "Linked Allocation" picker, so you can re-point a transaction to the correct allocation line; its quantity and cost move to that line's Net Used / Remaining / Actual automatically. (This build also fixes the category dropdown text that was showing at half height.)
